description: Use this to find a bounded set of the authenticated user's Contacts by preferred name, alias, or exact email/phone metadata. Duplicate candidates are returned separately; do not use names to choose or link a Contact automatically.
name: list_contacts
title: List Sidekick contacts

description: Use this after a Contact UUID is known to retrieve that owned active Contact and bounded current Project/Task context. Do not use it to resolve an ambiguous name, retrieve archived/future-domain data, or read another user's context.
name: get_contact_context
title: Get bounded Contact context

description: Use this only when the user has asked to create one Contact. Optional aliases and metadata are stored only in Sidekick; no message or external lookup occurs. Safe to retry with the same key and payload.
name: create_contact
title: Create a Sidekick contact

description: Use this for explicit edits to one known owned active Contact. Supply the observed version; omitted fields stay unchanged and explicit null clears optional metadata. Do not use this for aliases or work links.
name: update_contact
title: Update a Sidekick contact

description: Use this when the user explicitly wants to hide one known Contact from active views. Archive is reversible, preserves typed links, and does not delete Contact data.
name: archive_contact
title: Archive a Sidekick contact

description: Use this when the user explicitly wants to return one archived owned Contact to active views. It does not restore or modify related Projects or Tasks.
name: restore_contact
title: Restore a Sidekick contact

description: Use this to add one alternative name to a known active Contact using its current version. Equivalent aliases on the same Contact are not duplicated; the same alias may identify other Contacts.
name: add_contact_alias
title: Add a Contact alias

description: Use this only when the user wants to remove one known alias ID from an active Contact. It deletes that alias record but not the Contact or any work link.
name: remove_contact_alias
title: Remove a Contact alias

description: Use this only after the user-selected Contact and Project UUIDs are known. It records that the Project involves the Contact; it does not alter either record or contact an external system.
name: link_contact_to_project
title: Link a Contact to a Project

description: Use this only when the user wants to remove the known Contact–Project relation. It deletes the semantic link but does not delete or edit the Contact or Project.
name: unlink_contact_from_project
title: Unlink a Contact from a Project

description: Use this only after the user-selected Contact and Task UUIDs are known. It records that the Task concerns the Contact; it does not alter either record or contact an external system.
name: link_contact_to_task
title: Link a Contact to a Task

description: Use this only when the user wants to remove the known Contact–Task relation. It deletes the semantic link but does not delete or edit the Contact or Task.
name: unlink_contact_from_task
title: Unlink a Contact from a Task

description: Use this for a bounded date-filtered list of at most 366 inclusive calendar days of the authenticated user's journal entries. Content is omitted unless explicitly requested; do not use it for another user or unbounded history.
name: list_journal_entries
title: List Sidekick journal entries

description: Use this for one known owned entry UUID. Include content only when the user explicitly requested it; inaccessible IDs disclose no existence detail.
name: get_journal_entry
title: Get one Sidekick journal entry

description: Use this for bounded entries and summary status on one explicit date. Entry content is opt-in and no AI generation occurs.
name: get_journal_day

anyOf.description: Closed structured content shared by manual and AI-assisted summaries.
anyOf.title: SummaryContent

title: Get one Sidekick journal day

description: Use this to read the owned summary content, entry provenance, and current, stale, or failed status for one explicit date. It never generates or updates a summary.
name: get_daily_journal_summary

anyOf.description: Closed structured content shared by manual and AI-assisted summaries.
anyOf.title: SummaryContent

title: Get a Sidekick daily journal summary

description: Use this only when the user asks to preserve manual or transcript text for an explicit date. It creates an immutable source or replacement and invokes no AI.
name: create_journal_source
title: Create an immutable Sidekick journal source

description: Use this to finalize one committed owned source with user-authored fields and selected active relations. A source can create at most one entry; an existing entry conflicts. It invokes no AI and cannot create or update Tasks.
name: create_manual_journal_entry
title: Create a manual Sidekick journal entry

description: Use this when the user wants a bounded list of their Sidekick projects. Do not use it to list tasks or another user's data.
name: list_projects
title: List Sidekick projects

description: Get one owned project by its Sidekick UUID, including its current fields. Returns no cross-user existence detail.
name: get_project
title: Get one Sidekick project

description: Create one project for the authenticated user. This writes durable state and requires a retry-safe idempotency key.
name: create_project
title: Create a Sidekick project

description: List bounded tasks owned by the authenticated user, optionally filtered by project and status.
name: list_tasks
title: List Sidekick tasks

description: Get one owned task by its Sidekick UUID. Returns no cross-user existence detail.
name: get_task
title: Get one Sidekick task

description: Create one standalone or project task. This writes durable state and requires a retry-safe idempotency key.
name: create_task
title: Create a Sidekick task

description: Update explicit fields on one owned task using its current version. This writes durable state and is retry-safe.

changes.description: Explicit patch object retaining omitted-versus-null semantics.

name: update_task
title: Update a Sidekick task

description: Mark one owned task complete using its current version. Repeating the same idempotency key safely returns the committed result.
name: complete_task
title: Complete a Sidekick task
